full_details: At Bishopsgate the Rose's bill was nailed by the Bull. The title was Mahomet. There was no author and no price. Ralph Raye had seen it. He gave it in a breath: rant in the old Tamburlaine vein, fireworks, and a head that speaks. You asked what the head says. He said nothing worth the powder. He went on to Titus at the Cross Keys. You are not in that Titus, and you did not go. You went back up to the desk. You wrote how fast London tires of thunder, and how slowly it tires of a face. You struck two lines and did not put them in the folder. The folder still has two leaves. At dinner the loaf was a finger short, at threepence, and the packet was still waiting for Thursday. Titus went on at the Cross Keys without you. The Rose played Mahomet in the afternoon. You were at neither.
one_sentence: You read Mahomet on the post by the Bull, and you spent the rest of the day at the desk.
title: Read Mahomet on the bill and stayed at the desk
